named-query.name: GetExtensionDetails
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.cdcNo = :cdcNo and A.mobileNo = :mobileNo and A.isAuthorisedPerson = :isAP

named-query.name: GetUserExtensionDetails
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.cdcNo = :cdcNo and A.userID in :userID

named-query.name: GetSignerExtensionDetails
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.userID in :userID and A.signerID is not null

named-query.name: GetLoginExtensionDetails
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.userID in :userID and A.loginID is not null

named-query.name: GetAPUserData
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.cdcNo = :cdcNo and A.signerID is not null

named-native-query.name: ListResetLoginPinUserByCDCId
named-native-query.query: select a.user_id,a.login_id,'Login Pin',b.firstname,a.login_pin_ref,a.last_updated_date,dept.dep_code,a.CREATED_BY from DIGX_CZ_UM_EXTENSIONDATA a , DIGX_UM_USERPROFILE b , digx_cz_user_id_maintenance aa, (select distinct user_name,dep_code from digx_cz_fw_hostusersession) dept where a.user_id=b.u_name and a.login_pin_status in ('Inactive','Being Reset') and cdc_no = #cdc_no and cdc_no=aa.party_id(+) and a.login_id=aa.id(+) and a.login_pin_ref=aa.pin_ref_no(+) and aa.last_updated_by=dept.user_name(+)

named-native-query.name: ListResetSignerPinUserByCDCId
named-native-query.query: select a.user_id,a.signer_id,'Signer Pin',b.firstname,a.signer_pin_ref,a.last_updated_date,dept.dep_code,a.CREATED_BY from DIGX_CZ_UM_EXTENSIONDATA a , DIGX_UM_USERPROFILE b , digx_cz_user_id_maintenance aa, (select distinct user_name,dep_code from digx_cz_fw_hostusersession) dept where a.user_id=b.u_name and a.signer_pin_status in ('Inactive','Being Reset') and a.signer_id is not NULL and cdc_no = #cdc_no and cdc_no=aa.party_id(+) and a.login_id=aa.id(+) and a.login_pin_ref=aa.pin_ref_no(+) and aa.last_updated_by=dept.user_name(+)

named-native-query.name: ListResetPhonePinUserByCDCId
named-native-query.query: select USERNAME,ID,PIN_REF_NO,'Phone Banking',LAST_UPDATED_DATE,dept.dep_code from DIGX_CZ_USER_ID_MAINTENANCE, (select distinct user_name,dep_code from digx_cz_fw_hostusersession) dept where party_id = #cdc_no and id_type = '03' and pin_status in ('Inactive','Being Reset') and last_updated_by=dept.user_name(+)

named-native-query.name: ListResetLoginPinByCDCId
named-native-query.query: select ID,'Login Pin',PIN_REF_NO,LAST_UPDATED_DATE,dept.dep_code from DIGX_CZ_USER_ID_MAINTENANCE, (select distinct user_name,dep_code from digx_cz_fw_hostusersession) dept where username is null and id_type='02' and pin_status in ('Inactive','Being Reset') and party_id = #cdc_no and last_updated_by=dept.user_name(+)

named-native-query.name: listUsersData
named-native-query.query: select a.firstname,a.u_name,b.delete_status,b.lock_status,c.is_Ap,c.signer_id,c.cdc_no,a.mobileno,a.email, case when h.close_id is not null then 'HTH' else 'BCO' end as user_channel_type, h.close_id as close_id from digx_um_userprofile a join users b on a.u_name=b.u_name join digx_cz_um_extensiondata c on a.u_name=c.user_id left join HTH_BEA.HTH_USER_PROFILE h on h.party_id=c.cdc_no and h.close_id=c.user_id where c.cdc_no like #partyId and a.firstname like #firstName and a.email like #emailID and a.mobileno like #mobileNo and c.user_id like #userName ESCAPE '\'

named-query.name: GET_DUPLICATE_TXN
named-query.query: SELECT t from Transaction t JOIN t.entityIdentifiers e WHERE t.approvalDetails.status = :approvalStatus and t.transactionName = :transactionName

named-native-query.name: UpdateSignerHoldStatus
named-native-query.query: update digx_cz_um_extensiondata set signer_hold_reason='Retry Count Exceeded', signer_hold_status='No Activity Allowed' where user_id = #userID and cdc_no = #partyId

named-query.name: updatePasswordExpiryDate
named-query.query: UPDATE Users a set a.pwdExpiryDate = :pwd_expiry_date WHERE a.key.userName = :u_name

named-query.name: updatePasswordExpiryDateAndForceChangePassword
named-query.query: UPDATE Users a set a.pwdExpiryDate = :pwd_expiry_date, a.forceChangePassword = :forceChangePassword WHERE a.key.userName = :u_name

named-query.name: SEARCH_USERGROUP_BY_CUSTOMER
named-query.query: SELECT a from UserGroup a where a.name =:name and a.determinantValue = :determinantValue and a.partyId = :partyid

named-query.name: fetchUserGroupListByUsername
named-query.query: SELECT a from UserGroupUser a where a.entity.value = :username

named-query.name: fetchGroupIdByName
named-query.query: SELECT a from UserGroup a where a.name = :groupName

named-native-query.name: ListSignerByPartyId
named-native-query.query: select distinct user_id from DIGX_CZ_UM_EXTENSIONDATA where cdc_no = #partyId and is_ap = '1'

named-query.name: deleteUserFromGroup
named-query.query: DELETE FROM UserGroupUser a WHERE a.entity.value = :username and a.key.id = :id

named-query.name: updateUserLocale
named-query.query: UPDATE UserExtensionData a set a.userLocale = :userLocale WHERE a.userID = :username and a.cdcNo = :cdcId

named-query.name: UpdateSignerHoldStatusAndAttempts
named-query.query: UPDATE UserExtensionData a set a.signerPinstatus = 'Inactive', a.signerHoldReason = 'Retry Count Exceeded', a.signerHoldStatus = 'No Activity Allowed', a.signerAttempts = :attemptNumber where a.userID = :userID and a.cdcNo = :partyId

named-query.name: UpdateSignerAttempts
named-query.query: UPDATE UserExtensionData a set a.signerAttempts = :attemptNumber where a.userID = :userID and a.cdcNo = :partyId

named-native-query.name: preLastLoginDeteForUserId
named-native-query.query: select u_name, pre_last_loggedin_datetime from digx_um_userprofile where u_name = #userId

named-native-query.name: UpdateMigrationStatus
named-native-query.query: update digx_cz_um_extensiondata set migration_status=#migrationStatus where user_id=#userId

named-native-query.name: getFileContentCCBAudit
named-native-query.query: select FILE_NAME, FILE_CONTENT from MIG_AUDIT_LOGS where CCB_PARTYID = #partyId

named-native-query.name: getFileContentCCBSystemAudit
named-native-query.query: select FILE_NAME, FILE_CONTENT from CCB_SYSTEM_AUDIT_LOGS where CCB_PARTYID = #partyId

named-query.name: listNonDeletedUsersByParty
named-query.query: select a from UserExtensionData a , Users b where a.userID = b.key.userName and b.deleteStatus = :deleteStatus and a.cdcNo = :cdcNo

named-native-query.name: getPartyIDForAccount
named-native-query.query: select partyid from digx_pi_party_accounts where account_number = #accountId and parent_party_id = #partyId

named-native-query.name: getProductCodeForMasterAccount
named-native-query.query: select product_code from digx_pi_party_accounts where master_account_number = #masterAccountNumber

named-native-query.name: getPartyNameInformation
named-native-query.query: select customername from digx_pi_party_preferences where partyid = #partyId

named-native-query.name: getRelatedPartyInformation
named-native-query.query: select related_party_first_name from digx_pi_partytoparty_relation where party_id = #partyId and related_party_id = #relatedPartyId

named-native-query.name: readTimerJvmID
named-native-query.query: select jvm_id from digx_cm_timer where timer_id = #id

named-query.name: ListUserExtensionData
named-query.query: select A FROM UserExtensionData A WHERE A.userID like :userID
